quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 1,688.45 million, up 40.72% YoY; net profit attributable RMB 321.43 million (+91.08%). Datacom, consumer and industrial interconnect revenue RMB 1,480.19 million, up 51.63%, 87.67% of revenue, gross margin 52.89% (+7.24 points), driven by AI and data-center compute growth; telecom revenue RMB 202.35 million, down 8.63% on the industry downcycle and competition. Overseas sales were 69.30% of revenue.

quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product progress (half-year report): 400G/800G AEC solutions completed staged customer acceptance; the 1.6T AEC long-reach solution entered market promotion; 25G/400G/800G multimode optical module solutions were upgraded and the 1.6T optical module series completed solution selection and design; 50G PON is in volume delivery; 32-channel 150GHz AAWG in volume; MEMS optical switches and OCM passed customer verification and entered market promotion; high-precision fiber arrays are moving to 72 channels and above and 2D arrays.
